definitions.explanation: The process of organizing, prioritizing, and tracking tasks and to-do items, especially in a work or project context. Encompasses both the concept and the tools (apps, boards, lists) used to manage tasks.

examples.japanese: タスク{管理|かんり}にアプリを{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: I use an app for task management.

examples.japanese: チームのタスク{管理|かんり}を{改善|かいぜん}するために{新|あたら}しいツールを{導入|どうにゅう}した。
examples.english: We introduced a new tool to improve the team's task management.

examples.japanese: タスク{管理|かんり}がうまくできないと、{締|し}め{切|き}りに{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなくなることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: If you can't manage your tasks well, you often end up missing deadlines.

notes:
Composed of タスク (task, from English) and {管理|かんり} (management). A term widely used in modern Japanese workplaces, particularly in IT, project management, and office environments. The concept has become mainstream with the spread of digital productivity tools.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- タスク{管理|かんり}ツール: task management tool
- タスク{管理|かんり}アプリ: task management app
- タスク{管理|かんり}を{徹底|てってい}する: to thoroughly manage tasks
- {個人|こじん}のタスク{管理|かんり}: personal task management

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {進捗管理|しんちょくかんり}: progress management — focuses on tracking how far along work is
- {工程管理|こうていかんり}: process management — managing the sequence of work stages
- スケジュール{管理|かんり}: schedule management — focuses on time and calendar coordination
- {業務管理|ぎょうむかんり}: work management — broader term covering all aspects of work operations
